title: sync_hop.c: Division by zero if CONFIG_LICHEN_SYNC_HOP_SUPERFRAME_MS is 0
description: Line 42: If the config macro CONFIG_LICHEN_SYNC_HOP_SUPERFRAME_MS evaluates to 0, the division causes undefined behavior (crash on most platforms). Fix: add compile-time assertion BUILD_ASSERT(CONFIG_LICHEN_SYNC_HOP_SUPERFRAME_MS > 0).
